environment.description: Flask application deployed on a single EC2 instance (Amazon Linux 2, t3.medium) behind an NLB (Network Load Balancer, TCP passthrough on port 443 with TLS termination at instance). Security group allows inbound 443 from 0.0.0.0/0. No additional proxy or filtering layer. Application runs directly via gunicorn with 4 workers. SQLite database on local EBS volume. HMAC_SECRET set via environment variable in systemd unit file.

config.load_balancer: NLB with TCP listener, no HTTP inspection
